$about: capability -> the code globs that must move with its spec (R11). Keys starting with $ are metadata, not capabilities.
Dependency manifests, lockfiles, generated files (router.ts, drizzle/**) and tests-only data are not behaviour: they stay out of the globs (specs/enforcement.md, map hygiene).
Skeleton services (order, course, billing, admin, ai) have no behaviour yet; each gets its capability entry when its first procedure is specced (bf-new-module).
